final: WITH college_income AS (SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS college_total FROM income AS i JOIN member AS mb ON mb.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major AS m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major GROUP BY m.college), all_income AS (SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM income) SELECT ci.college, ci.college_total, 1.0 * ci.college_total / ai.total FROM college_income AS ci CROSS JOIN all_income AS ai WHERE ai.total IS NOT NULL
